{{Quote|Anytime, anywhere&hellip; we're there.|Czerka Arms' motto|<ref name="Codex: Czerka Corporation">{{TORcite|type=codex|Czerka Corporation}}</ref>}}
'''Czerka Arms''', also known as '''Czerka Weapons''', formerly known as the '''Czerka Corporation''' and '''Czerka Interstellar''', and founded as '''Czerka Mining and Industrial''', was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning mega-corporation during the reigns of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

It controlled interests on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Telos IV]] and to a much lesser extent [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] along with countless other [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The corporation exported many of their weapons to [[Justa starport|Justa Starport]] on [[Mutanda]]. At the time of the [[Old Sith Wars]], the business was at its zenith, because they had influence of half of the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the galaxy and so Czerka was considered to be a monopoly.  

In [[3638 BBY]], the Republic nationalized the Czerka Corporation and dissolved it as an entity; however, the corporation's former employees regrouped into [[Czerka Interstellar]], and the company eventually took on the name Czerka Arms.

==History==
{{Quote|Czerka Corporation. Centuries of service&mdash;a heritage to be proud of. Now accepting lifetime-employment applications...|Holoboard on Coruscant.|<ref name="TLS1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>}}
''Czerka Mining and Industrial'' was founded at the dawn of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] with a charter to explore and settle resource-rich worlds. This business model quickly proved limiting, so the Czerka Board of Directors agreed to diversify into the security market. Czerka’s operations expanded rapidly, allowing the company to grow in the years that followed.<ref name="guide">[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]</ref>

=== Czerka Corporation ===
Some years before the [[Great Droid Revolution]] of [[4015 BBY]],<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Czerka, already known as ''Czerka Corporation'' and having grown rich on weapons development, experimental research and planetary exploration, discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and named it ''Edean''. Initially interested in planet's natural resources, the company sent their scouts to investigate; when they encountered the native Wookiee population, Czerka realized that this species is the true wealth of the world. Bringing in an overwhelming force, Czerka established a position on Kashyyyk, setting up a wookie slave trade.<ref name="datacron:kashyyyk">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 40: Czerka Discovers Kashyyyk}}</ref> Although slavery was illegal in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], on Kashyyk it became possible due to legal loopholes concerning the planet's location. This lucrative market was ended only centuries later, when the visiting [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], along with his Wookiee companion [[Zaalbar]], helped instigate a [[Rebellion on Kashyyyk/Legends|revolt]] resulting in the Wookiees driving the company from the planet.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

During the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], Czerka, under the leadership of [[President/Legends|President]] [[Pollard Seario]], extensively invested into [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], leading to the founding of [[Dreshdae]] on the latter.<ref name="Korriban">{{LucasArts|url=products/swkotor/W_korriban.html|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic - Korriban}}</ref> In the war, Czerka allied itself with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]; corporation supplied the contemporary [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] armies and the Sith supplied exclusive trade rights on conquered planets. Not least because of this, Czerka gained a reputation as an unethical opportunist.<ref name="KotOR" />

[[File:Czerka.svg|thumb|left|Symbol of Czerka Corporation]]
[[File:CzerkaCorporateEnforcer-KotORCG.png|thumb|right|150px|A Czerka corporate enforcer during the era of [[Old Sith Wars]]]]
At the same time, Czerka's enterprise on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] ended in a financial failure. Responding to enthusiastic surveys, a number of outposts, including the town of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], were built and mining operations begun. To its subsequent dismay, Czerka become another in a long line of companies deceived by Tatooine's inferior, quickly corroding [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. Nevertheless, such an investment had been made that officials were unwilling to close it down and the sale of ore from Tatooine continued. Customers and investments declined, and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|marauding bands of natives]] also proved a source of trouble for the corporation. Revan became involved here as well when the administrator of Anchorhead hired him to butcher the local tribes of Sand People. The amnesiac [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], unknowably to his employer, deftly avoided this by negotiating a reduction in attacks with the tribes' [[Sand People chieftain|chieftain]].<ref name="KotOR" /> 

From the native [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]], company scientists also attempted to breed "war dewbacks" that were larger and more aggressive than their easily domesticated cousins. Although the scientists eventually succeeded, the project was written off as a failure when the test herd broke out of its enclosure and rampaged through the research facility.<ref name="Codex: Dewback">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dewback}}</ref> Eventually, however, Czerka did depart Tatooine, abandoning their [[CZK Sandcrawler|sandcrawlers]] and their settlements.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

In the years after the war, Czerka sought to ingratiate itself with the victorious but shaken [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] through involvement in the [[Telosian Restoration Project|reconstruction effort]] of [[Telos IV]]. Czerka supplied workers and investment in exchange for exclusive access to Telosian resources, including rights to any abandoned war matériel. Success, it was hoped, would bring the company similar contracts on other reconstruction projects. Czerka, however, clashed with the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] running the project and the Telosian [[Bumani Exchange Corporation|branch]] of [[Exchange]], which already acquired control of several restoration zones&mdash;all of which soon were ruined. If not for the [[Skirmishes on Citadel Station|intervention]] of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], Telos might well have followed.<ref name="KotOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

In [[3743 BBY]], a [[Research vessel]] [[Theoretika]] owned by Czerka and carrying schematics for [[HK-51 series assassin droid|HK-51]] assassin droids, was damaged during its hyperspace jump and ended up in an asteroid belt in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Ship's medical droids malfunctioned and reclassified the remaining food stores as infested, and destroyed them by enacting pesticide protocols, leading to crew's death.<ref name="Fatality">{{TORcite|type=general|The Fatality / Fatal Errors|[[Section X]]}}</ref>

A few decades later, [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] got Czerka's attention once again, when corporate archeologists discovered an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] cave in the Dune Sea. To study the cave and artifacts within, a secret research [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|facility]] was constructed, with the science team lead by director [[Yem Antayen]]. However, activation of one of the artifacts - a [[mind prison]] keeping a long forgotten [[The Imprisoned One|alien]] - resulted in a disaster, and everyone present at the facility who did not have a chance to escape was transformed into walking dead puppets possessed by the ancient Rakatan.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" />

In [[3668 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] ordered a shipment of [[HK-51 series assassin droid|HK-51]] assassin droids from Czerka, intending to unleash them on the Republic. However, the Imperial vessel [[Fatality]], with an army of HK-51 droids on board, crashed on Belsavis.<ref name="Fatality" />

[[File:CzerkaUniform-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|Czerka security officer during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]]]
By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Czerka was noted to have diversified businesses ranging from consumer food products to military weapons. It owned multiple star systems, employed several billion individuals and had representation in the Republic [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. It was also unique, being able to negotiate trade agreements with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and independent worlds, crossing political borders with impunity to generate staggering profits. Whatever one may have thought about Czerka Corporation's business practices, no one could afford to simply stop doing business with them.<ref name="Codex: Czerka Corporation" /> During this period, Czerka became victim to several [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] attacks. The company's officials offered a reward to any other slicer who could help stop the security breaches.<ref name="SLI">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|An Open Contract}}</ref>

In [[3643 BBY]], [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Republic Strategic Information Service (SIS)]] conducted an [[SIS operation on Tatooine|operation]] to unravel the nature of the Czerka [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|facility]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which existence became known due to an information leak at the hands of ex-corporate accountant [[Kamus Orden]]. To stop the Republic from discovering the truth about the disaster, the Corporation sent [[Gayem Leksende]] - the head of the Czerka Special Enforcement branch - to deal with the situation. Following his own agenda, Gayem failed to prevent SIS from rediscovering the base, and was killed in a confrontation.<ref name="The Thing Czerka Found" /> Kamus Orden was taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to testify against various Czerka crimes including attempts on his life, which added to an ongoing critique of the Corporation.<ref name="mail Kamus">{{TORcite|type=message|Life after Czerka!|Kamus Orden}}</ref>

=== Reorganization ===
{{Quote|The Republic's defiled our name. Perhaps we'll rebrand. But we'll never abandon Czerka's signature dedication to quality.|[[Eva Kaayz]]|<ref name="titans" />}}
The discussion of Czerka's ethics culminated in [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date2.3">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref> some time after the [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]]'s [[New Empire|failed coup]], when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] has decided to shut down the Czerka Corporation due to years of corruption and criminality. To avoid absorption by the Republic, many of the company's executives have turned to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] to retain their independence. However, one of the Czerka executives, [[Rasmus Blys]], the administrator of a [[Czerka facility (CZ-198)|secret weapons facility]] on the moon [[CZ-198]], refused to take sides and locked the moon down. In order to capture CZ-198 and seize the weapons inside, both the Republic and the Empire sent their strike teams to fight for the moon, eventually defeating Rasmus Blys, and plundering the equipment.<ref name="corporate labs">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=flashpoint|Czerka Corporate Labs}}</ref> In the wake of these events, the former Czerka employees, wishing to retain the Republic market, reorganized the corporation into "[[Czerka Interstellar]]", which by exploiting several loopholes in the Republic's law allowed Czerka to continue operating in the Republic.<ref name="ons">[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]</ref> 

=== Czerka Interstellar ===
In [[3622 BBY]]<ref name="Date7.8">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref>, during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian Civil War]], heavily-shielded Czerka personnel with a number of battle droids and [[Czerka Probe droid|spy probes]] infiltrated the wreckage of a bio-research vessel [[Jannimak]] [[Crash of the Jannimak|crashed]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], to acquire the scientific data, but were stopped by [[Galactic Solutions Industries|Galactic Sustainability Institute]]'s contractors.<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]</ref>

=== Czerka Arms ===
Czerka, renamed again as ''Czerka Arms'', continued its existence for many centuries. After the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]], Czerka sold their products freely during the days of the Galactic Republic, for example selling [[Outland rifle/Legends|Czerka Outland Rifles]] to the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] during their [[Huk War|war]] with the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Huk]],<ref name="USTSOGG">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> but signed an exclusivity contract with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when it rose to power.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', p. xiv</ref><ref name="NEGWT" /> However, Czerka munitions made their way to aftermarket sales from warehouses, despite the official stance of the company. One example of this was the [[ZX miniature flame projector/Legends|Czerka ZX miniature flame projector]] used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Booba">[[Boba Fett's Armor: An Essential Guide to a Walking Weapon]]</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Czerka was on the list of legitimate targets for [[Rebel privateer]]s.<ref name="Rebel Privateers!">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref><ref name="Pirates & Privateers">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] replaced the Galactic Empire, Czerka ended its contract with the Empire and offered its products once more to the galactic market, even going so far as to actively pursue production contracts with the New Republic. Czerka maintained its position as the third-largest weapons manufacturer in the galaxy, superseded only by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] and [[Merr-Sonn Industrial Equipment|Merr-Sonn]]. Czerka produced some energy weapons, but found a niche in the manufacture of non-[[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] personal weapons and "non-standard" munitions, such as [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projectors]], [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], and [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]].<ref name="NEGWT" />

== Reputation and ethics ==
Czerka, at least in its earlier days, was widely known as a successful, if unscrupulous, corporation. Illegal and unethical revenue-generating practices were tolerated, sometimes encouraged, by its sectoral officers so long as the flow of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was uninterrupted and word did not leak out. Likewise, the politics of its customers were overlooked for the sake of lucrative markets. Also, as might be expected in such a corporation, rumors spread of profiteering; particularly that Czerka officials had allowed starvation of colonists when their high prices were not met. This distaste did not, however, compromise Czerka's income.{{Fact}}

During the wars between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Czerka was a sponsor in the Hutt-run death game, Huttball, supplying many of the death traps used in the popular sport.<ref>{{TORcite|type=other|Warzones}}</ref>

Czerka also engaged in the illicit slave trade. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], one of the main sources of such proft were Wookiees from Kashyyyk, regarded as savage brutes because of their animalistic speech and appearance. Violent resistance by the Wookiees only reinforced this belief. Nevertheless, negotiations with the usurper [[Chuundar]] led to a mutual aid agreement in which Czerka supplied him with weapons with which to enforce his rule and he supplied Czerka with slaves. As previously described, this agreement was ended when Revan aligned himself with Chuundar's deposed father [[Freyyr]] and encouraged a revolt. Chuundar was killed, and Czerka evicted. Czerka sought to conceal the setback through a public announcement that it was "scaling back" regional operations but was met with skepticism; the deaths of so many personnel led to questions regarding their "reassignments" which Czerka refused to answer.<ref name="KotOR" />

[[File:Dern1.jpg|thumb|[[Dern]], a Czerka Corporation employee during the [[Old Sith Wars]]]]

On Telos IV, Czerka's illicit actions came to light and caused repercussions for the whole corporation. Under the effective leadership of [[Jana Lorso]], encroachments were made into the Ithorians within [[Chodo Habat]]'s reconstruction team's sphere of influence. Alliance with the Exchange and deft exploitation of Telos' own laws enabled Lorso to steadily marginalize the Ithorians. The arrival of Meetra Surik changed this; befriending Chodo and his herd, she gathered information which exposed Czerka's activities.<ref name="KotOR2" />

The Prosecution's case rested on the following evidence:
#Evidence collected from the mainframe (showing Czerka's alliance with the [[Exchange]], among other things);
#The ambush of [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] personnel by the Exchange, attempting to steal the Ithorians' new droid-intelligence for Czerka (which only achieved the loss of all the assassins involved in the attempt, while the defenders suffered only minor wounds);
#The testimony of ex-Czerka employee and dock-officer-turned-[[Telos Security Force|TSF]]-informant [[Batono]];
#Czerka's failed attempt to bribe Meetra Surik into assassinating Batono, and:
#Their later failed attempt to do so using two mercenaries (who were killed by Surik, along with [[Atton Rand]] and [[Kreia]]);
#The arrest of a Czerka employee with black-market dealer [[Samhan Dobo]] during a meeting, in which the TSF, aided by Surik, subdued Samhan and arrested both of them, as well as said employee's statements before the arrest tying other members of Czerka to the black market;
#The brutal annexation by Czerka of Ithorian [[Restoration Zone]]s, to which [[Bao-Dur]] and the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]''{{'s}} crew could testify;
#And most persuasive of all, Czerka's blatant attempt to try to kill all the Ithorians using mercenaries, which led to the deaths of many Ithorians. [[Chodo Habat]], [[Moza]], and the other Ithorians only survived due to the timely arrival of the Meetra Surik, who killed all the mercenaries.

In the end, Czerka was ordered to leave all Telosian holdings and to stand trial, and that it was fully removed by the time of the [[Battle of Telos IV]].<ref name="KotOR2" />

== Visual Identity ==
[[File:CZ rasmus stands ready.jpg|thumb|Czerka [[Rasmus Blys|Executive]] standing in front of the "Czerka Sunrise" flag, accompanied by officers in Czerka uniform|241x241px]]
Czerka Corporation had a distinct visual style that almost didn't change with time. Uniform of a Czerka official could remain closely the same for centuries, allowing those who did not follow the company's developments instantly recognize it.<ref name="Last One Out">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Last One Out|Tatooine}}</ref> Though not as standardized at the time of the [[Old Sith Wars]], when it was common to see a Czerka official in local clothing instead of a corporate suit, by the time of of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Czerka's visual identity became monolithic. Both sentient personnel and various droids utilized by the corporation, from humanoid assassins to [[Czerka tripod battledroid|tripod battledroids]] and probes, were typically distinguished by shades of [[Color/Legends|''green'']] with ''gold'' patterns and lines. Combination of these two colors was also the coloring choice for company's flags and banners, widely used around the time of the Cold War.<ref name="TOR" />

Corporate spaces and offices were utilizing ''cyan''; it was the color of navigation markers and signs, as well as holographic banners of the corporation's logo. Information screens at Czerka facilities, from buffet menus to floor maps, were glowing in cyan. Cyan was also the secondary color of typically white Czerka's furniture.<ref name="CZ-198">{{TORcite|type=location|[[CZ-198]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Czerka Arms was first created for ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', released by [[West End Games]] as a supplement for its [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. It was featured in the Legends video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' and its sequels, ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', although not the primary villain, appearing as an occasional antagonist faction. Czerka is presented as an amoral entity; not only are they frequenty allied or doing business with the Sith, but they frequently use underhanded means for their ends, such as stealing from rivals, acting on purely financial motivations, employing the use of violence and [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], hiring [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] weapons, etc. They will often ask the player to perform some jobs which would generally be considered "dirty".
